name: Values
overview: Scripture reveals that true values are rooted in integrity, humility, and trust in the LORD rather than in wealth or human understanding. A good name and loving favor are esteemed above riches, emphasizing character over material gain. God requires His people to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Him, while training children in godly ways ensures lasting faithfulness. These principles guide believers to prioritize eternal virtues over temporal possessions, especially in the realm of money and values.
